title: Bristol Hum Unexplained Noise

scenes.text: Residents hear a low‑frequency hum that never stops

scenes.query: map of Bristol UK city centre
scenes.text: The phenomenon is reported throughout the city of Bristol, England
Measurements show the hum at about 58 Hz with a 250 Hz second tone
BBC documentary still of a resident pointing to a vibrating window

scenes.label: UNSOLVED SOURCE
scenes.sub: Theories range from industrial equipment to geological activity, but none proven

scenes.text: Follow if you can't stop asking why.

description: A persistent low‑frequency hum haunts Bristol, measured at 58 Hz, yet scientists cannot pinpoint its origin. Is it machines, the earth, or something else? Follow for more strange sound stories.
